_comment: Install at <stateDir>/push-config.json (default ~/.envoyhome/push-config.json). Repo-root copy is only used when the daemon cwd is the repo. Desktop packaging stages from repo root or ~/.envoyhome into resources/push/.
_comment_sandbox: Product default is false (api.push.apple.com) — pairs with RunnerRelease.entitlements / TestFlight / App Store. Only override with APNS_SANDBOX=1 for Xcode debug / flutter run development APS.
